opportunities.host: Smart Networks and Services Joint Undertaking (SNS JU)
opportunities.program_family: Call for Experts 2026 - Evaluators for EU Research Projects
opportunities.title: SNS JU Call for Experts 2026: Evaluators for Beyond-5G, 6G and Smart Networks Research Projects
aliases: Call for Experts 2026 - SNS JU is looking for evaluators for its EU research projects
opportunities.deadline: Rolling / no fixed deadline stated; EU expert database registration remains open and SNS JU application instructions remain active as of 2026-09-11
opportunities.programme_dates: Short-term assignments distributed across a few weeks or several months depending on SNS JU call schedules; project evaluation and monitoring assignments
opportunities.location_format: Primarily remote; some on-site meetings may be required in Brussels or other European cities
opportunities.funding_stream: EU Funding & Tenders Portal independent expert contract for SNS JU assignments
opportunities.funding: Paid: selected EU experts normally receive EUR 450 per full day worked. Travel and subsistence costs are reimbursed when travel is contractually required; remote evaluation may use the EU simplified fee methodology.
opportunities.exact_official_funding_evidence: SNS JU states that compensation includes daily fees and, where applicable, travel and accommodation expenses. The EU Funding & Tenders Portal Online Manual states that experts normally receive EUR 450 per full day worked and that travel and subsistence costs are refunded.
opportunities.category: 6G / beyond-5G / telecommunications / network security / AI and data science / smart networks / standards / research evaluation
opportunities.eligibility: Minimum 5 years of experience in relevant fields; strong technical background in telecommunications, networks or related areas; excellent analytical/evaluation skills; excellent written and spoken English; no conflicts of interest with ongoing SNS JU activities.
opportunities.institution_eligibility: PASS: professionals from research institutions and academia are explicitly targeted; application is individual through the EU expert database and is not restricted by institution country.
opportunities.nationality_eligibility: PASS: the EU Funding & Tenders Portal Online Manual states that expert registration is open to experts of any nationality, including outside the EU and Associated Countries; Pakistani citizenship is eligible.
opportunities.residence_eligibility: PASS: expert registration is international and assignments can be performed remotely; Spain residence is not disqualifying.
opportunities.career_stage_eligibility: PASS: SNS JU explicitly seeks professionals from research institutions and academia with at least 5 years of relevant experience. Stored career records show more than 10 years of professional experience and 4-7 years in security, including relevant networking, 5G/6G, cybersecurity, research and academic roles.
opportunities.age_rule: Age 38 eligible: neither the SNS JU 2026 expert call nor the comprehensive EU expert registration/manual rules state an age condition or upper-age limit.
opportunities.prerequisites: Create or update an EU Login and Expert Database profile, specify 5G/6G/smart-network expertise, complete all profile sections, attach an updated CV, and optionally notify SNS JU of interest. Selection is assignment-specific and subject to conflict-of-interest rules.
opportunities.fit_explanation: Exceptional direct fit with Sameer’s 5G/6G, B5G, network-security, AI/ML and research-evaluation profile, including expertise in network slicing, secure resource allocation and adversarial network resilience.
